findings.title: J-INTERRUPTION-LEDGER refuses every owner-valid ledger with a completed verify step
findings.evidence: B1b: an authoritative AnalysisResult with kind=verify plus verification is shape-valid (invocation:3 AnalysisResult authoritative branch kind enum [analysis, verify]; kind=verify requires verification). The owner repair_verify emits kind 'verify' (workflows_model.v1.py:1913). B2: [verify, render] ledgers from the successor model at cut 1 (before-settle), cut 2 (after-settle) and no signal are all record- and envelope-valid but refused with J-INTERRUPTION-RESULT-KIND. ledger_join.py:53 maps verify steps to expected_kind 'analysis'. B3: the converse, a verify step carrying kind=analysis without verification, is admitted.
findings.impact: repair-apply [repair-preview, repair-apply, verify, render] and repair-verify [verify, render] can never pass the mandatory join, and neither can the settled path that runs the same step loop. Root's 72 scenarios include no verify step.
findings.required: Require result.kind == spec.kind for analysis and verify (verify => kind=verify), plus the existing kind == step kind for the others. Add owner-valid verify ledgers (before-settle, after-settle, committed verify Run carrier, verify after optional analysis) to the checker.

findings.title: The interruption error policy admits two outputs per ledger; it must be one deterministic rule
findings.evidence: C0/C1/C2: a shape-valid ledger with a recorded CONFIG.INVALID detail admits both errors=[] and [CONFIG.INVALID]. C10: a committed kind=run carrier admits the recorded detail and also its omission. C11: kind=invocation with errors is shape-valid and admitted. C6-C8: exact order is enforced, but only once nonempty. C9: a real rejection whose detail was not persisted gives recorded list [], so the empty form is selected silently and the composed detail is refused. author06 (subject-06 contract.md:110-114; report_model.failure_envelope) always sets errors = recorded_failure_details for an interrupted failure: empty exactly when none are recorded.
assessmentAgainstOwners: workflows-and-surfaces.md:1340-1344 says errors equal the termination's domainDetail 'so the two surfaces never disagree'. That is an exactness rule, not an optional projection.

Report delivery goldens require identical aggregate/exit/delivery across human/json/agent/html. A two-valued rule makes the golden ambiguous across hosts or releases, even if each emission is internally consistent.

Neither side is exhaustive projection of the ledger: optional-step failures (C2) and skipped PRECONDITION_FAILED terminations are included and excluded by the same recorded-detail filter in both proposals.

The persistence duty (host composes the route detail into StepTermination.domainDetail before projection) is sound, but no join can observe it (C9). It must be a named ledger-admission duty on every request-rejected/operational-failed step, not only when interrupted.
findings.recommendedSingleRule: For a before-settle interruption: errors := recorded_failure_details(stepResults), meaning the in-step-order domainDetails of non-cancelled request-rejected/operational-failed steps. The new empty form is then exactly the case where that list is empty. On a kind=run or kind=invocation carrier, errors must be absent or equal that same list; choose one and state it. Apply the persistence duty at step recording for every such step. State explicitly whether optional-step failure details are included (both proposals currently include them; settled D9 never surfaces them).
findings.required: Adopt one rule in ledger_join, the prose override and author06 together; add the C1/C10 cases as refusals (or as the chosen exact form).

findings.title: The no-commit failure branch still admits Run-derived payloads outside result_fields
findings.evidence: C12: kind=failure with a recorded detail plus findings (from a committed Run golden) is shape-valid under envelope6 (the non-empty-errors form is not restricted by the new not list) and admitted by the join. result_fields omits findings, advisoryReport and availability. advisoryReport is shape-refused anyway (C13).
findings.required: With no committed Run, refuse findings (and advisoryReport defensively). Keep availability only if the owner confirms it is invocation-scoped.
